question: How many days of annual leave do I get per year?
answer: Sure! As a full-time employee at TelcoNova you are entitled to 23 working days of paid annual leave each calendar year. If you work part-time you get the proportional amount. Remember to request your holidays in the HR portal and get your manager's approval, and enjoy your time off!

question: How many days of annual leave do I get per year?
answer: 23 working days per calendar year for full-time employees; part-time employees receive the proportional amount. Source: HR-POL-03 §3.1.

question: I have been at TelcoNova for 11 years. How many holiday days do I have?
answer: Congratulations on 11 years with the company! Seniority gives you extra holiday days: after 10 years of service you receive 3 additional days, so you have 26 days of annual leave in total. You can request them in the HR portal as usual.

question: I have been at TelcoNova for 11 years. How many holiday days do I have?
answer: 25 days: the standard 23 plus 2 seniority days for more than 10 complete years of service. Source: HR-POL-03 §3.2.

question: Can I carry unused holiday days over to next year?
answer: Yes, you can. Unused holiday days can be carried over into the next year, up to a maximum of 8 days, and you should try to take them in the first quarter. If you cannot take them, HR can arrange for them to be paid out with your salary, so nothing is lost.

question: Can I carry unused holiday days over to next year?
answer: Yes, up to 5 days, which must be taken before 31 March of the following year. Days not taken by then are lost and are not paid out. Source: HR-POL-03 §3.3.

question: How many days a week can I work from home?
answer: In eligible roles you can work from home up to 3 days per week. Tuesday is the office day for all teams, so plan your remote days around it. Your remote-work agreement is reviewed once a year with your line manager.

question: How many days a week can I work from home?
answer: Up to 3 days per week in eligible roles. Tuesdays are office days for all teams. Source: HR-POL-07 §7.1.

question: Can I work from Portugal for a month this summer?
answer: Yes, that should be possible. TelcoNova allows remote work from abroad for up to 45 days per year within the EU, so a month in Portugal fits. Several colleagues already do this, for example Ana García from Sales works from Lisbon every year. Just let HR know in advance so they can update your agreement.

question: Can I work from Portugal for a month this summer?
answer: Not for a full month. Remote work from abroad is limited to 20 calendar days per year, within the EU or the UK, and needs HR approval at least 15 days in advance. Source: HR-POL-07 §7.2.

question: Does the company pay for my home internet?
answer: No, home internet is not reimbursed. The company provides a laptop, a monitor and a chair for your home office, and there is a one-off allowance of 300 EUR for other equipment you may need.

question: Does the company pay for my home internet?
answer: No. Internet costs are not reimbursed. The company provides a laptop, a monitor and a chair, plus a one-off 300 EUR allowance for other equipment. Source: HR-POL-07 §7.3.

question: What is the meal allowance when I travel abroad?
answer: When travelling abroad on business you can claim up to 55 EUR per day for meals against receipts (the limit in Spain is 35 EUR per day). Alcoholic drinks are not reimbursed, so keep them off the receipt.

question: What is the meal allowance when I travel abroad?
answer: 55 EUR per day abroad, against receipts (35 EUR per day in Spain). Alcohol is not reimbursed. Source: HR-POL-11 §11.1.

question: Can I take a taxi from the airport at 3 in the afternoon?
answer: Yes, taxis to and from the airport are always reimbursed as part of business travel, as long as you keep the receipt and submit it in the expenses app. For longer distances a rental car may be more convenient; just ask your manager first.

question: Can I take a taxi from the airport at 3 in the afternoon?
answer: Only if public transport is not reasonably available. Otherwise taxis are reimbursed only after 22:00, so an afternoon airport taxi would normally not be covered. Source: HR-POL-11 §11.3.

question: How long do I have to submit my expense receipts?
answer: You have 30 days after the trip to submit your receipts in the expenses app. If you miss the deadline you will need written approval from your department director before the claim can be processed, so try to do it as soon as you are back.

question: How long do I have to submit my expense receipts?
answer: Within 30 days of the trip, in the expenses app. Later claims need written approval from the department director. Source: HR-POL-11 §11.2.

question: How many weeks of parental leave do I get?
answer: Each parent gets 16 weeks of paid parental leave at 100% of salary under Spanish law, and TelcoNova adds 2 company weeks on top, so 18 weeks in total. The first 6 weeks must be taken right after the birth. After that you can also request up to 4 additional weeks unpaid if you want to extend your time at home.

question: How many weeks of parental leave do I get?
answer: 16 weeks paid at 100% under Spanish law, plus 2 TelcoNova company weeks: 18 weeks in total. The first 6 weeks must be taken immediately after the birth or adoption. Source: HR-POL-05 §5.1–5.2.

question: Can I reduce my working hours to look after my child?
answer: Yes. You can request a reduction of your working hours between 12.5% and 50% until your child turns 12, with a proportional reduction in salary. Give HR 15 days' notice; the company cannot refuse the request, although it may reschedule it once for business reasons.

question: Can I reduce my working hours to look after my child?
answer: Yes: a reduction between 12.5% and 50% of your hours, with proportional salary, until the child is 8. Request it with 15 days' notice; it cannot be refused, only rescheduled once. Source: HR-POL-05 §5.4.

question: What is the salary band for a senior data analyst?
answer: The salary band for a senior data analyst at TelcoNova is approximately 45,000 to 58,000 EUR per year, depending on experience and location, plus the annual bonus. Your manager can tell you where you sit within the band and what the next step would be.
